plainLanguage: Section 95 inalenga public-service official anayetoa return au statement inayohusiana na payment/delivery na anajua kuwa ni false katika material particular.
meaning: Liability under section 95 depends on the exact public-service role, conduct, knowledge or interest requirements stated by the provision.
keyPoints: Person must be employed in public service in the specified capacity.
The return/statement must concern a matter described by the section.
Falsity must be in a material particular.
Knowledge of that falsity is expressly required.

history.summary: Section 95 is in Chapter X, Abuse of Office, Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Official text checked against the government R.E. 2022 source.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Public-office offences should be analysed from the exact statutory duties, interests and mental elements.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Official status alone is not enough; evidence must establish the specific conduct required by the section.

debateQuestion: Je, evidence inathibitisha kila statutory element ya section 95?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
